== Learn from the configs ==

=== Preface ===

Not many people are doing config editing for OFP / ArmA.<br>
'''However configs are actually a very powerful tool to tweak the engine to your liking.'''
'''Even better writing configs is quite simple.'''

There are three general problems though:
* You cannot make screenshots from your config work most times. Yet the actual player will give you props way more than pure visual changes or additions. Even more important apart from pure reskins, missions, scripts and simple file replacements configs are an essential part of any addon!
* Beginners can easily get overstrained by the amount of content in configs. In addition you can get puzzled by topics like config structure, inheritance, testing process and effect validation. Especially as BI made the overall config structure with bin.pbo in dta and the various configs in the addons folder very complicated and hard to handle.
* You even found your way to the BIKI. BI did a good start with the BIKI in terms of engine documentation. However you will soon find out that configs is the topic was least documentation. So prepare yourself to do a lot of testing and forum research.

'''You can influence the engine and game very direct and effective by config editing. Don't give up easily and enjoy!'''

=== Special features of the PROPER Mod ===

Every addon released by the PROPER Mod team has a special structure to allow people analyze our work and learn from it.<br>
Features in detail:
* Simple, feature specific addon. <br>This means that every logical change is separated into one single pbo to make the changes very clear and easy to understand.
* Advanced inner structure. <br>Each addon contains a single config.cpp. This file only points to the rest of the content via [[PreProcessor_Commands#Preprocessor_commands|#include]] statements. Textures, sounds, config values are separated into various subfolders. Configs are separated into at least into cfgPatches.hpp and Core.hpp.
* Documentation. <br>The Core.hpp (to be found in the '''\h''' subfolder) contains (technical) comments at the top about the changes done by the addon. Sometimes even additional information about config values are described.
* Study and learn. <br>PROPER Mod addons aim for high (technical) quality and (hopefully) no errors to be found in the [[arma.RPT|ArmA.RPT]]. So for example more complex topics like working class inheritance and properly updating existing class can be found in our work. 

== Installation ==

=== Preface ===

'''NEVER ever put addons (pbo files) in the ArmA\addons folder!'''<br>


 NOT RECOMMENDED TO BE USED IN MULTIPLAYER! THIS WILL BE CONSIDER CHEATING!
 NOT TESTED IN MULTIPLAYER - THERE IS ALWAYS THE CHANCE TO CRASH THE SERVER WITH
 MODIFIED DATA - DON'T USE IT IN MP. PERIOD.

 If the server and all clients would use it, it is a different matter of course.

=== Instructions ===

Just put the single pbo file from any PROPER Mod addon in a [[Arma: Mod Folders|Modfolder's]] addon folder. Like
 ..\ArmA\@PROPER\addons\PROPER_example.pbo

=== Additional information ===

* Every addon of the PROPER Mod can be used '''independently''' from the other PROPER Mod addons. Of course some addons are meant to be used in combination.<br>
* Conflicts with other peoples' addons / work should be very unlikely due to the way our work is made (config structure / config inheritance).<br>
* '''Addons are loaded alphabetically in terms of modfolder and PBO name. Way more important are requiredAddons dependencies of cfgPatches though. They determine which addon (or more precise down to each config value) is used / active, as the config is only loaded once all requiredAddons have been loaded. So a lot of dependencies make the addon loaded late'''.

== Server key file ==

You can find the {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/proper.bikey|proper.bikey here}}.<br>
This file is needed on the dedicated server in .\ArmA\keys

== BISign ==

You can download each bisign file individually too. Just add a '''.PROPER.bisign''' extension to the pbo download link. Like<br>

 PROPER_Gameplay_RadioProtocol_Fixed.pbo
 PROPER_Gameplay_RadioProtocol_Fixed.pbo.PROPER.bisign

However you can download all bisign files available {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/PROPER_All_BISign.rar|here (PROPER_All_BISign.rar)}} too.

== Linux server ==

For better readability the files still use case sensitivity.

{{Feature|important|Do not forget to make all files lower case only on a linux server machine!}}

== What about AI and PVP tags? ==

These two tags can sometimes be found at the end of an addon / pbo. Meaning:

* '''AI''' tag means the addon is recommended '''only''' for sp or coop.
* '''PvP''' tag means the addon is recommended '''only''' for human vs human (''no AI'') play.

We prefer gameplay over 'realism' here ({{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Sound_SupersonicCrack_Effect_Removed_supersonic_crack_close.wav|supersonic crack wav}}). [[File:Sound icon.png|20 px]].

=== PROPER Gameplay Sound TreeHit Added ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Sound_TreeHit_Added.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Added the missing treeHit sound. Used the former OFP sound hit: {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Sound_TreeHit_Added_treehit1.wav|treehit wav}}. [[File:Sound icon.png|20 px]].
** Possibly NON functional. Feedback needed!

=== PROPER Gameplay Vehicle All White Radar Signature PvP ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_All_White_Radar_Signature_PvP.pbo|(click to download)}}
** '''PvP only''': Makes all vehicles have a {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_All_White_Radar_Signature_PvP_New.avi|white radar signature}} [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]] {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/pictures/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_All_White_Radar_Signature_PvP_New.jpg|(Screenshot)}} [[File:Image icon.png|20 px]]. Therefore this disables radar / tab locking completely. {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_All_White_Radar_Signature_PvP_No_Tab_Rader_Lock.avi|Direct click}} [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]] and auomated AA launcher locking still works though. Former green / red radar targets: {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_All_White_Radar_Signature_PvP_Old.avi|video}} [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]], {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/pictures/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_All_White_Radar_Signature_PvP_Old.jpg|screenshot}} [[File:Image icon.png|20 px]]

=== PROPER Gameplay Vehicle GetInRadius Expanded ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_GetInRadius_Expanded.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Doubled getInRadius for all vehicles to make it more convenient ({{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_GetInRadius_Expanded.avi|expanded getInRadius demo video}}). [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]]

=== PROPER Gameplay Vehicle InsideSoundCoef ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_InsideSoundCoef.pbo|(click to download)}}
** It reduces sound volume inside vehicles significantly.
** '''Todo''': Add example video.

 If you dislike the fact that the (engine sound in particular) sound is way too
 loud if you are inside vehicles, you will love this one.<br>
 You will be happy to go easy on with your ears again and have a good voice chat
 with your buddies while being in some vehicle.<br>
 Note that the volume is still good in order to  hear all the things around you.
 Especially in the combination with the "PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_OccludeAndObstructSounds"
 addon... it is more like the sound is very pleasantly dampened.

=== PROPER Gameplay Vehicle Lock AI ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_Lock_AI.pbo|(click to download)}}
** '''AI only''': To make vehicle combat vs AI more enjoyable again, the tab/radar locking is re'enabled for all vehicle weapons as a workaround {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_Lock_AI_All_Vehcile_Weapons_CanLock.avi|(example video for DShKM)}} [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]].

 However you need to be the _weapon commanding guy_ in the vehicle.<br>
 You either need to activate manual control or switch to gunner for a moment as
 group leader to get the _weapon commanding guy_ status.
 After that the tab/radar locking also works for driver or commander in ground
 vehicles without commander slot present in the vehicle (these almost all
 besides M1Abrams, T72 and BMP2).

=== PROPER Gameplay Vehicle No Lock PvP ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_No_Lock_PvP.pbo|(click to download)}}
** '''PvP only''': To make vehicle combat in PvP less based on clicking and knowledge but rather more based on skill and make it more enjoyable locking is disabled for all vehicle weapons. {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_No_Lock_PvP_Only_Guided_CanLock.avi|Guided missiles}} [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]] like Strela, AA can still lock vehicles of course.

=== PROPER Gameplay Vehicle No Alarm Sound ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_No_Alarm_Sound.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Disables the annoying {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_No_Alarm_Sound_alarm_loop1.wav|alarm sound}} [[File:Sound icon.png|20 px]] when being hit as a vehicle.
** '''Todo''': Add example video.

=== PROPER Gameplay Vehicle No Eject Action ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_No_Eject_Action.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Removes the {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_No_Eject_Action_Old.jpg|Eject action}} [[File:Image icon.png|20 px]] {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_No_Eject_Action_New.jpg|menu entry}} [[File:Image icon.png|20 px]] and the shortcut key.
** This is a gameplay change. You can now only getOut of vehicles. This means you need to wait until the vehicle has halted. No more quick eject from driving vehicles possible.

=== PROPER Gameplay Vehicle No Switch Seat Action ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_No_Switch_Seat_Action.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Removes the {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_No_Switch_Seat_Action_Old.jpg|switchToXXX action}} [[File:Image icon.png|20 px]] {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_No_Switch_Seat_Action_New.jpg|menu entry}} [[File:Image icon.png|20 px]] and the shortcut key.
** This is a gameplay change. This should promote the use of 2/3 manned vehicles as a single guy has to getout and board the vehicle to switch to a different position now.

=== PROPER Gameplay Vehicle OccludeAndObstructSounds ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_OccludeAndObstructSounds.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Improve audio-visual awareness inside vehicles significantly.
** '''Todo''': Add example video.

 Well, did you ever felt lost in ArmA tanks - I am sure you did!<br>
 This is primarily due to the limited audio-visual awareness inside vehicles
 (compared to OFP in particular).<br>
 BI tried to introduce a fancy realism effect... as a result inside vehicles
 you are almost completely deaf. In other words unable to hear the surrounding
 sound scenery properly, like immediate hostile fire or even direct impacts at
 your vehicle.<br>
 This is a good day for you! With this addon, you shall become happy again!

=== PROPER Gameplay Vehicle StartEngine Disabled ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Vehicle_StartEngine_Disabled.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Disables the effect that the vehicle engine is activated once you turn the turret (as gunner or commander).

You may want to use NWD_RocketBallistics instead as its more comprehensive - yet it has still very high maneuvrability and hit rate for Stinger and Sidewinder rockets.

** Reduced and unified the infantry weapon dispersion for all weapons. It is now again: {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_Disperion_Disabled_New.avi|"where you aim, there you hit"}} [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]] principle. Very satisfying comparted to the {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_Disperion_Disabled_Old.avi|high disperion}} [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]] ArmA weapons like AK74PSO.
** Meant to be used in combination with [[PROPER:Mod#PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_Sway_Reworked|PROPER Gameplay Weapon Sway Reworked]].

=== PROPER Gameplay Weapon Dot Crosshair hedcrusha ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_Dot_Crosshair_hedcrusha.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Replaces the {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/pictures/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_Dot_Crosshair_hedcrusha_Old.jpg|weapon cursor}} [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]] for rifles, pistols and machine guns with a {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/pictures/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_Dot_Crosshair_hedcrusha_New.jpg|dot}} [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]].
** Full credit to hedcrusha for this great replacement! Thanks dude :-)

=== PROPER Gameplay Weapon HandGrenadeTimed Explosion OnImpact ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_HandGrenadeTimed_Explosion_OnImpact.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Disabled timed effect of the grenade and made in non bouncing ({{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_HandGrenadeTimed_Explosion_OnImpact.avi|expanded getInRadius demo video}}). [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]]

=== PROPER Gameplay Weapon No Dexterity ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_No_Dexterity.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Reduces vertical weapon sway for all infantry weapons besides launcher type weapons. Horizontal weapon sway does hardly exist (or not at all) for non launcher type weapons. So the delay is mainly / solely related to ones mouse sensitivity settings. Gives the player a lot more direct mouse control over the weapon.
*** {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_No_Dexterity_Old.avi|Old y-axis weapon delay / sluggishness}}. [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]]
*** {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_No_Dexterity_New01.avi|More precise weapon control demo video}}. [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]]
*** {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_No_Dexterity_New02.avi|More precise weapon control demo video2}}. [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]]
*** {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_No_Dexterity_Launcher.avi|Launcher weapons are still hard to handle}}. [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]]

 In addition you are recommended to double the y axis sensitivity value
 (mouseSensitivityY) based on your x axis value (mouseSensitivityX).
 The values are to be found in your "YourUser.ArmAprofile" file.
 Thanks to Ryan for the tip!

 The floatingZoneArea should be set to the very left (equals zero) too
 floatingZoneArea=0.000000;
 in order to get the best direct mouse control over the weapon.

=== PROPER Gameplay Weapon Sway Reworked ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_Sway_Reworked.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Infantry weapon sway reworked. Expanded all default ArmA values a little bit ({{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/gameplay/media/PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_Sway_Reworked_New.avi|demo video}}) [[File:Video icon.png|20 px]]
** Values might get an expanded even more in future updates.
** Meant to be used in combination with [[PROPER:Mod#PROPER_Gameplay_Weapon_Disperion_Disabled|PROPER Gameplay Weapon Disperion Disabled]].

== PROPER Anims ==

=== PROPER Anims Fast Forward Transition ===

* {{Link|http://www.proper.armaholic.eu/download/proper/anims/PROPER_Anims_Fast_Forward_Transition.pbo|(click to download)}}
** Sprint transitions are quite broken in ArmA. The idea is to replace sprint with run gameplay wise. This addon doubles the diagonal forward and straightforward run speed to make it equal to the sprint speed. In addition the diagonal forward and straightforward walk is accelerated by 150 percent to make it more useful. More info in the BI forum in the thread: {{Link|link= http://www.flashpoint1985.com/cgi-bin/ikonboard311/ikonboard.cgi?act=ST;f=69;t=69548;st=0|text=  Very buggy sprint (fast forward) transition..., What about a workaround?}}
